items.actClause:
AN ACT in relation to authorizing the city of Long Beach to alienate and
discontinue the use of certain parklands
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER: S5364

SPONSOR: CANZONERI-FITZPATRICK
 
TITLE OF BILL:

An act in relation to authorizing the city of Long Beach to alienate and
discontinue the use of certain parklands

 
PURPOSE:

To authorize the City of Long Beach to discontinue the use of certain
lands to construct, maintain and operate a subterranean conduit and
electrical distribution cable system.

 
SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS:

Section 1: Authorizes the City of Long Beach, acting through its govern-
ing body, to discontinue the use of parklands and alienate the lands for
the purpose of constructing, maintaining, and operating a subterranean
conduit and electrical distribution cable system, together with subter-
ranean transition joint bays and link boxes, and appurtenances thereto.

Section 2: Specifies that this authorization shall only be effective
upon the condition that the City of Long Beach dedicates an amount equal
to or greater than the fair market value of the parkland being discon-
tinued towards the acquisition of additional parklands and/or capital
improvements to existing parklands and recreational facilities.

Section 3: Describes the boundaries of the land authorized to be tempo-
rarily discontinued as parklands.

Section 4: Describes the boundaries of the land authorized to be perma-
nently discontinued as parklands.

Section 5: Provides that the land described in section 3 of this act
shall be restored and returned to the City of Long Beach for park
purposes after construction is completed.

Section 6: Provides that the discontinuance and conveyance of such park-
land shall not occur until the City of Long Beach has complied with any
federal and state requirements necessary to do so.

Section 7: Provides the effective date.

 
JUSTIFICATION:

This legislation was requested by the City of Long Beach, to authorize
the City to alienate parcels of parkland for the construction, mainte-
nance, and operation of a subterranean conduit and electrical distrib-
ution cable system, together with subterranean transition joint bays and
link boxes associated with an off shore wind energy facility. A portion
of the alienated parkland will be restored and returned to the City for
park purposes after construction is completed.

 
LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

New bill.

 
FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:
None to the state.

 
EFFECTIVE DATE:
This act shall take effect immediately.

summary: Authorizes the city of Long Beach to alienate and discontinue the use of certain parklands to EW Offshore Wind Transport Corporation for the purpose of constructing, maintaining and operating a subterranean conduit and electrical distribution cable system, together with subterranean transition joint bays and link boxes, and appurtenances thereto, under city of Long Beach parkland.
